t: A micro:bit smart car with sensors and lights, used in Year 3 to 6 lessons.
steps: Find the TPBot on the ELECFREAKS site or a reseller.
Buy a BBC micro:bit V2, a USB cable and 4 AAA batteries.
Attach the micro:bit with the gold pins facing down.
Open MakeCode in a browser and add the TPBot extension.
Download code to the micro:bit by USB.
Test on a Chromebook before class. Chromebook use was not confirmed.
